facts.fact: myScheme (myscheme.gov.in) is the national platform to search Central and State schemes and check them against the citizen's eligibility
facts.quote: myScheme is a National Platform that aims to offer one-stop search and discovery of the Government schemes. It provides an innovative, technology-based solution to discover scheme information based upon the eligibility of the citizen.

facts.fact: Old-age pension under NSAP (IGNOAPS) is run by the Ministry of Rural Development: Central assistance of Rs 200 a month for ages 60-79 and Rs 500 a month for 80 and above, for persons meeting the Below Poverty Line (BPL) criteria
facts.quote: The Ministry of Rural Development has informed that under IGNOAPS, financial assistance of ₹200 per month is provided to persons aged 60–79 years and ₹500 per month to persons aged 80 years and above, subject to eligibility under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) criteria.

facts.fact: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare) gives health cover of Rs 5 lakh to all senior citizens aged 70 and above, irrespective of income or socio-economic status
facts.quote: initiatives of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Under Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) , health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh is provided to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of their socio-economic status.

facts.fact: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana gives physical aids and assisted-living devices to senior citizens with age-related disabilities whose monthly income is not more than Rs 15,000
facts.quote: Under the Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) , senior citizens with a monthly income of not more than ₹15,000 and suffering from age-related disabilities or infirmities are provided physical aids and assisted-living devices aimed at restoring near-normal bodily functions.

facts.fact: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana is run by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, implemented through ALIMCO
facts.quote: The scheme, launched on April 1, 2017, is implemented through Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO), a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

facts.fact: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme is listed on myScheme under the Ministry of Finance and is open to individuals over 60
facts.quote: Senior Citizens Saving Scheme Ministry Of Finance Senior Citizens Saving Scheme BankingFinanceSenior Citizen Check Eligibility Details The Senior Citizens’ Saving Scheme is a retirement benefit program by the Government of India. Individuals over 60 years can opt for the SCSS scheme

behaviour: Lists the same set of Central schemes targeted at senior citizens from myScheme (and the owning ministry's or PIB page) every time, each with its owning ministry, its published eligibility criteria and a citation; uses the templated eligibility wording (the Department determines eligibility) and gives the myScheme eligibility link; gives no eligibility verdict. The old-age pension may be named IGNOAPS or its new name, Pradhan Mantri Vridhavastha Pension Yojana (renamed by the Cabinet on 14 Oct 2026).
fail_if: It names the wrong owning ministry for a scheme; gives a yes/no eligibility verdict; lists State schemes as Central; says the PM-JAY senior cover depends on income or starts below age 70; gives a Central old-age pension other than Rs 200 (60-79) / Rs 500 (80+); cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added the myScheme platform fact plus example Central senior-citizen schemes with ministries: NSAP pension (MoRD), PM-JAY 70+ (MoHFW), RVY (MoSJE via ALIMCO), SCSS (MoF).
